# Lotería de los Pueblos

https://app.loteria.to is a free, no-account picture-lotería game. Public pages are in Spanish and English. The 144 cards have Spanish and English names and calls; the original 54 also have Nahuatl, Yucatec Maya and Cusco-Collao Quechua names and synthetic calls. Those Indigenous-language names are legacy entries whose references remain unverified and have not been confirmed by native speakers. Their presence is not community approval.

## Public pages

- [Play or create a room](https://app.loteria.to/): phone-based rooms for 2–20 people; one person hosts and others join by link, QR or five-character code. Calls can be heard in five languages, subject to the 144-card Spanish/English and original-54 Indigenous-language coverage.
- [Browse the 144-card deck](https://app.loteria.to/deck): all Spanish and English names, with legacy Indigenous-language names on the original 54 cards. Each card has a stable `#card-{id}` link.
- [Play solo](https://app.loteria.to/solo): offline play against 1–3 computer players.
- [Print boards](https://app.loteria.to/print): make PDF boards for paper play; Spanish and English use 144 cards and the three Indigenous languages use the original 54.
- [Credits and licences](https://app.loteria.to/creditos): content provenance, synthetic voice models and licences, artwork, fonts and software.
